name: JoAi: Draft Contact Message

title.en: Draft a message for a contact
title.es: Draft a message for a contact
title.fr: Draft a message for a contact
title.ro: Draft a message for a contact
title.it: Draft a message for a contact

description.en: Draft a personalized CRM message using a contact's unified timeline, including activities and conversation history. The result is returned for review and is never sent automatically.
description.de: Entwirf anhand der einheitlichen Kontakt-Zeitachse mit Aktivitäten und Gesprächsverlauf eine persönliche CRM-Nachricht. Der Entwurf wird nur zur Prüfung zurückgegeben und niemals automatisch gesendet.
description.es: Draft a personalized CRM message using a contact's unified timeline, including activities and conversation history. The result is returned for review and is never sent automatically.
description.fr: Draft a personalized CRM message using a contact's unified timeline, including activities and conversation history. The result is returned for review and is never sent automatically.
description.ro: Draft a personalized CRM message using a contact's unified timeline, including activities and conversation history. The result is returned for review and is never sent automatically.
description.it: Draft a personalized CRM message using a contact's unified timeline, including activities and conversation history. The result is returned for review and is never sent automatically.

bot: Use when the user wants a personalized draft for a CRM contact. Provide the contact ID, the reason for writing, and optional verified context; return the draft for review without sending it.

inputs.name: Contact ID

description.en: CRM contact to draft the message for
description.de: CRM-Kontakt, für den die Nachricht entworfen wird

inputs.bot: The hash ID of the CRM contact.

inputs.name: Reason

description.en: Why the message should be sent now
description.de: Warum die Nachricht jetzt sinnvoll ist

inputs.bot: Examples include following up on an inquiry, checking in after a purchase, thanking the contact, or reconnecting.

inputs.name: Context

description.en: Optional verified context not yet recorded in the timeline
description.de: Optionaler geprüfter Kontext, der noch nicht in der Zeitachse steht

inputs.bot: Only provide facts known to be true, such as a recent event or a specific topic to mention.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
